title: Rotate right
prompt: Implement `int[] rotateRight(int[] arr)`: a NEW array shifted right by one, last element wrapping to the front. Write the two failure cases (length 0 and 1) into your loop before running anything.

tests.name: rotated copy
tests.hint: out[0] = arr[arr.length-1]; out[i+1] = arr[i] for i in 0..length-2; handle empty first.
